Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
We generated $2.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 168 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1464 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $2.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 4% to 17% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
